notices.text: Dubai job applications open - Urgent vacancy for Hotel & Facility Staff! Details dekhein.
Poland Warehouse & Logistics Worker requirements open - Free accommodation provided.
Gulf & European Country Visa Processing & Document Attestation Express Service.

opportunities.title: Dubai Hotel & Hospitality Staff
opportunities.facilities: Free Accommodation, Transport, Food allowance, Medical Insurance & 2 Years Contract with Visa
opportunities.eligibility: Age: 21-38 years. Minimum 10th/12th Pass. Basic English ya Hindi communication. Freshers & experienced both eligible.
opportunities.charges: Government visa fees + medical & documentation charges. Detailed breakdown given after selection.
opportunities.documentsRequired: Passport copy (Minimum 1 year validity), 4 Passport-size photos (white background), Education certificates, Updated Resume (if available)

opportunities.title: Poland Warehouse Packing & Logistics Assistant
opportunities.facilities: Company provided stay/hostel, subsidized food, European Work Permit (TRC support eligible), Overtime bonus
opportunities.eligibility: Age: 20-45 years. Physically fit. No prior IELTS required. Hardworking attitude.
opportunities.charges: Official Polish Work Permit approval charges, VFS appointment & flight ticket costs. Transparent structure.
opportunities.documentsRequired: Valid Passport, PCC (Police Clearance Certificate), Education proofs, Medical fitness certificate

opportunities.title: Saudi Arabia Electrician & AC Technician
opportunities.facilities: Sharing accommodation, Iqama provided, Medical insurance, 42 days paid leave after 2 years
opportunities.eligibility: Age: 22-42 years. ITI / Diploma / Technical trade certificate or minimum 2 years field experience.
opportunities.charges: Visa stamping + Gamca Medical + Emigration charges as per government guidelines.
opportunities.documentsRequired: Original Passport, Trade/Skill Certificate, Experience Certificate, White background photos

opportunities.title: Gulf & European Work/Tourist Visa Assistance
opportunities.facilities: Complete file preparation, Embassy appointment booking, Interview guidance & Visa tracking
opportunities.eligibility: Valid passport holders seeking genuine employment or travel visas.
opportunities.charges: Consultation & file preparation fee. Embassy visa fees as per country tariffs.
opportunities.documentsRequired: Passport, Bank statement/financial proof, Photographs, Purpose statement

opportunities.title: MEA Apostille & Embassy Document Attestation
opportunities.facilities: Notary, SDM, State HRD, MEA Apostille & Embassy stamping door-to-door delivery assistance
opportunities.eligibility: Anyone planning for overseas job, higher studies or immigration.
opportunities.charges: Standard government attestation fee per certificate + nominal processing charges.
opportunities.documentsRequired: Original Degree / Marksheet / Marriage / Birth Certificate + Passport copy

applications.message: Dubai me waiter ya front desk job ke liye interested hu. Passport ready hai.

internalNotes.note: Candidate se call par baat hui. Fluent Hindi aur basic English bol leta hai. Passport valid till 2030.
